Analyst commentary (as at report date)
Top-performing countries (Strong)

15 countries score ≥95% with no Insufficient Control answer. Honduras, Costa Rica and the three French Caribbean territories lead. Caution: Martinique, Guadeloupe and French Guiana have identical answer profiles (53/2/0/6) and 31 of 55 applicable answers without uploaded evidence – their Strong rating should be confirmed by evidence review. USA and Chile are Strong on controls but each has 4 overdue actions.
Countries with moderate control

13 countries score ≥90% with Insufficient answers ≤5% of applicable questions. Nicaragua (93.6%), Paraguay (93.9%) and Panama (94.2%) have the lowest scores in this group because of many Moderate answers (9, 9 and 5). Canada has 3 Insufficient answers plus 3 overdue actions. Uruguay declares 43% of questions N/A – applicability should be validated.
Countries with weak controls
Barbados (5 Insufficient, score 89.9%) and Cayman Islands (3 Insufficient, 6% of applicable answers). Barbados has 6 action-plan items NOT STARTED and all overdue.
Countries requiring immediate attention (Critical)

Bahamas (6 Insufficient = 11.1% of applicable answers, score 88.4%) and Bermuda (6 Insufficient = 12.2%, score 87.2%) exceed the 10% Insufficient threshold. Bahamas has 3 overdue NOT STARTED actions; Bermuda reports all 7 actions COMPLETED while 6 controls remain Insufficient – completion should be verified.
Countries with insufficient data

No country is in this category: all 32 forms contain a Control Level for all 61 questions. 18 further countries in '5.Policy Tracker 2026' (mainly agent countries) have no assessment worksheet and are not ranked.

Main regional improvement priorities (ANALYTICAL recommendations derived from the findings above)

Launch a regional Customs training programme (Policy 2.5) with a country-specific curriculum and training log – first in the 9 Caribbean countries with Insufficient Control; align with the draft regional action in 'Regional Actions Draft'.
Run a procedure-refresh campaign (Annex 1): template, owner and deadline per country; 17 countries have outdated or incomplete local procedures.
Make declaration quality reviews (4.14) and root-cause / CAPA processes (4.3, 4.11, 4.13) mandatory routines with a regional reporting format; start with Mexico, Bahamas, Jamaica, BVI.

Targeted RCCH intervention for Bahamas and Bermuda (Critical) and Barbados and Cayman Islands (Weak): joint remediation plan, monthly follow-up, independent verification of actions reported COMPLETED.
Clear the 21 overdue actions and add actions for the 19 control gaps without one; require real dates and standard statuses (data validation now added to all Action Plan sheets).

Evidence verification: sample-test answers rated UNDER CONTROL without uploaded evidence (French Caribbean, Trinidad, Haiti, Paraguay first) and validate high N/A declarations (Uruguay 43%, Costa Rica 28%).
Have Regional Management validate the scoring weights and classification thresholds in 08 – Config & Methodology before the results are used for formal country ratings.
